svg.title: An independent Bernstein calculation proves more than the grid cover for this frozen reader. For v = u + (w −u)z, write each remaining-t risk polynomial in Bernstein form of degree t. A child has degree t −1, and every local kernel is affine in z. If bi,h,k denotes the node’s coefficient, its exact recursion is bi,h,k = t −k ∑︂ o Ku(o | h, ai)bjo,h,k + k ∑︂ o Kw(o | h, ai)bjo,h,k−1,
